oracle.purpose: Supplementary Chromium 153 CSS layout oracle for common native document Flex geometry.
oracle.capture: Actual local CSS Flex layout; DOMRect geometry is measured in CSS pixels relative to the container border box.
oracle.network: All page requests are blocked; pages use only authored synthetic HTML and CSS.
oracle.content: Empty colored boxes only; no text content or font-dependent measurement.
oracle.geometry: Coordinates and dimensions are rounded to 0.001 CSS pixels; all captured numeric values are finite.
oracle.fixedWebBaseline: Reference only: bd3d90981271e1f93cf3d1d1a5bbf9b61136b74c. This supplementary capture does not replace or rewrite the fixed web baseline or earlier Chromium 154/155 observations.

input.description: Three flex: 1 items divide a 360px row equally.
Positive free space is distributed by grow factors 1, 2, and 3.
Positive free space is distributed after pixel flex bases.
Percentage flex bases resolve against the inner row width before growing.
Fixed pixel flex bases leave positive free space at the main end.
Fixed percentage flex bases are sized from the inner row width.
Equal shrink factors reduce three 180px bases into a 420px row.
Shrink factors weight the scaled flex-base loss at 1, 2, and 3.
Zero shrink factors keep three 120px items wider than their row.
A minimum width freezes one item and redistributes remaining free space.
A maximum width freezes one growing item and redistributes remaining free space.
Minimum and maximum violations freeze separate items before the third is refilled.
Column gap separates items within lines and row gap separates three wrapped lines.
Only row gap is present between two rows; items within each row touch.
Four fixed-width boxes wrap into two rows at the available width.
Three wrapped lines are stacked from the cross-end in a definite-height container.
A row-reverse container lays out items from its right main-start.
An RTL row lays out its first item from the right main-start.
RTL direction and row-reverse both affect the resolved main-start.
Three flex: 1 items share a definite 300px column height.
Column grow factors 1 and 2 share free height after a 12px row gap.
An auto-height column keeps explicit item heights and grows to their sum.
An auto-height column with auto bases preserves the explicit natural heights.
A column-reverse container lays out boxes from its bottom main-start.
Positive main-axis free space with justify-content: flex-start.
Positive main-axis free space with justify-content: flex-end.

Positive main-axis free space with justify-content: space-around.

Negative main-axis free space with justify-content: space-evenly.
Negative main-axis free space with justify-content: center.
Different item heights are centered in a definite-height row.
Different item heights align to the cross-end of a definite-height row.
Auto-height items stretch to the definite row cross size.
Center alignment does not stretch items with explicit heights.
The middle item overrides container stretch with align-self: flex-end.
Two flex lines use align-content: stretch in a definite-height container.
Two flex lines use align-content: center in a definite-height container.
Two flex lines use align-content: space-between in a definite-height container.
The two-value gap shorthand sets 8px row gaps and 12px column gaps.
The flex-flow shorthand sets row direction and wrapping together.
The flex-flow shorthand sets a reversed column main axis.
Grow factors totaling 0.4 consume only 40 percent of positive free space.
Shrink factors totaling 0.4 consume only 40 percent of negative free space.
A fixed-height column wraps its fifth item into a third column.
RTL direction places column-wrap lines from the cross-end across a fixed-width container.
A 100px flex basis includes item padding and borders under border-box sizing.
A 320px border-box container includes its padding and border in its declared width.
Stretch alignment is clamped by a maximum cross size and a separate minimum cross size.
A display:none box remains in the authored child list but occupies no flex space.
The declared container size is content-box and padding and border offset its children.
Pixel flex bases use content boxes while padding and borders enlarge outer item rects.
A nested flex item keeps its 160px automatic minimum beside a fixed 100px sibling.
A nested 80px and 60px row with a 10px gap takes its auto basis and leaves 150px for a flexible sibling.
A 600px media query changes the flex direction at a 390px viewport.
A 600px media query changes the flex direction at a 768px viewport.
